hashes.algorithm: SHA-256 truncated to 128 bits, lowercase hex (32 characters)
hashes.contract_id: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace and no NaN/Infinity, excluding top-level contract_id, golden_hash and expected_contract_id fields. The expected value lives in a golden sidecar.

instrument.description: Thirteen-band binaural spatializer for a live Harmonic Beacon analog signal, plus a native looping nature-WAV layer summed onto the stereo output.
instrument.native_namespace_rule: The existing /beacon namespace and its indexed band controls are authoritative. This instrument is not a common gain/pan/phase voice model.

stream_identity.stream_id: Random 64-bit lowercase hexadecimal value generated once per beacon.scd process start.
stream_identity.scope: state_seq and monotonic client state are scoped to stream_id.
stream_identity.restart_rule: A new stream_id invalidates cached state and requires a fresh state synchronization.

counters.state_seq: Unsigned monotonic OSC int64 (h), incremented for every accepted control change and every state snapshot emitted by the instrument.

handshake.rebroadcast: Sent in reply to /beacon/hello/request and approximately every hello_rebroadcast_s to clients learned through hello or state requests.

capabilities.name: band_gain

arguments.name: gain
arguments.polarity: 0 = silent; 1 = nominal per-band gain; values above 1 add gain up to 3.

capabilities.smoothing: Exponential-style lag in the SynthDef via lag(0.05).

capabilities.name: band_azimuth

arguments.name: azimuth_degrees
arguments.polarity: Negative and positive values rotate in opposite directions around the horizontal plane; 0 is front.

capabilities.smoothing: Exponential-style lag in the SynthDef via lag(0.05); values are converted from degrees to radians for FoaPanB.

arguments.name: distance
arguments.polarity: Increasing values attenuate the wet contribution by 1/distance; DSP clamps the divisor to 0.1.

arguments.name: solo
arguments.polarity: 0 = not soloed; 1 = soloed. If any band is soloed, only soloed bands pass.

capabilities.name: band_filter_rq

arguments.name: reciprocal_q
arguments.polarity: This is SuperCollider BPF rq (bandwidth divided by center frequency), despite the legacy q address name; larger values produce a wider band.

capabilities.smoothing: Exponential-style lag in the SynthDef via lag(0.05).

arguments.name: master_gain
arguments.polarity: 0 = silent; 1 = unity final gain; values above 1 add gain up to 3.

capabilities.name: nature_load

arguments.name: path
arguments.meaning: On write, an absolute local path to a readable, non-empty mono or stereo WAV. On state read, the active standardized path, or an empty string when no nature buffer is active. Invalid paths are rejected without replacing the active layer.

capabilities.smoothing: No value smoothing; a valid replacement becomes active only after its stereo playback buffer is ready.

capabilities.name: nature_gain

arguments.name: gain
arguments.polarity: Bounded linear amplitude: 0 = silent and 1 = unity. The receiver and SynthDef both clamp to this range.

capabilities.smoothing: Exponential-style gain lag in the sample-player SynthDef via lag(0.05).

commands.name: record_start

arguments.name: path
arguments.meaning: Output WAV path. An empty string selects the engine's timestamped default path.

commands.legacy_argument_coercion: The existing engine applies asString to the first OSC argument; contract-conforming clients send an OSC string.

state_sync.response: One atomic bundle beginning with /beacon/state/begin(stream_id, state_seq, contract_id), followed by current values for all 68 readable native addresses (66 core spatial controls plus nature load path and gain), and ending with /beacon/state/end(stream_id, state_seq).
state_sync.connect_rule: After a matching /beacon/hello, a client MUST request /beacon/state with the accepted contract_id and complete the dump before presenting or modifying instrument state.
state_sync.mismatch_rule: A missing or mismatched expected_contract_id produces no state dump.

receiver_rules.client_gating: A client MUST NOT send capability writes until /beacon/hello contract_id exactly matches the locally accepted contract_id and state synchronization completes.
receiver_rules.stale_contract: On a missing or mismatched contract_id, stop writes, discard state messages, mark the instrument incompatible and request /beacon/hello again.
receiver_rules.instrument_gating: The current UDP adapter cannot prove client identity across datagrams, so it preserves legacy writes from any source admitted by the configured listen rule; adapters that can identify negotiated clients MUST ignore writes from clients without a matching handshake.
receiver_rules.monotonic_discard: Within one stream_id, discard state updates with state_seq less than or equal to the last applied state_seq, except members of the same atomic state dump.
receiver_rules.stream_change: A new stream_id clears cached state and requires a fresh dump.
receiver_rules.argument_validation: Clients MUST send the declared OSC types and finite in-range numeric values. Existing spatial controls preserve their unclamped OSC write semantics; nature gain is clamped to 0..1, and nature load rejects non-absolute, missing, unreadable, non-WAV, empty, or non-mono/stereo files without replacing the active layer.
